title_convention: Short descriptive source labels, not verbatim article titles.

completeness.status: Nine declarations individually verified against dated WHO primary pages; cross-checked against the WHO IHR committee index and targeted 2025/2026 declaration searches. No additional declaration before cutoff identified; this is not a certified immutable archive audit.
completeness.excluded_uniformly: Continuation meetings, renewals, emergency terminations, national or continental declarations, and committee meetings that did not declare a WHO PHEIC.

rule.name: hypothetical_generic_WHO_PHEIC_watch
rule.interpretation: Hindsight-informed scenario watch, not a market-crisis probability, not historically preregistered, and not evidence of three-pillar predictive skill.
rule.evaluation_requirement: Retain every event and every watch session, including false alarms and missing market coverage. Report external-only, pillars-only, and combined results separately.

events.title: WHO initial H1N1 emergency decision
events.evidence_excerpt: the Director-General has determined that the current events constitute a public health emergency of international concern

events.title: WHO polio international-spread emergency decision
events.evidence_excerpt: on 5 May 2014 declared the international spread of wild poliovirus in 2014 a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

events.title: WHO West African Ebola emergency decision
events.evidence_excerpt: on 8 August 2014 declared the Ebola outbreak in West Africa a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

events.title: WHO neurological-cluster emergency associated with Zika
events.evidence_excerpt: constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.
events.source_context: The declared event was the cluster of microcephaly and other neurological disorders, associated with Zika; not an assertion that every Zika infection is a PHEIC.

events.title: WHO eastern DRC Ebola emergency decision
events.evidence_excerpt: outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

events.title: WHO novel-coronavirus emergency decision
events.evidence_excerpt: The Director-General declared that the outbreak of 2019-nCoV constitutes a PHEIC
events.source_context: This is the January PHEIC decision, not the later March pandemic characterization. Meeting hours are reported, but an exact first-publication timestamp is not established here.

events.title: WHO first mpox emergency decision
events.evidence_excerpt: I have decided that the global monkeypox outbreak represents a public health emergency of international concern.

events.title: WHO renewed mpox emergency decision
events.evidence_excerpt: This PHEIC determination is the second in two years relating to mpox.

events.title: WHO Bundibugyo Ebola emergency decision
events.evidence_excerpt: constitutes a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC), but does not meet the criteria of pandemic emergency
events.source_context: The WHO page records a later correction to a reported Kinshasa case. Only the declaration and displayed date are used; case counts are not reconstructed from the revised page.
